reference_hedgehog: The hedgehog Calloway has lived by: be the best at getting struggling K-2 readers to grade level through intensively trained, closely coached one-to-one tutors working inside partner districts. Economic denominator: students reaching spring benchmark per dollar (or per coached tutor-year). Passion: early literacy and developing young tutors, many of whom become teachers.
hedgehog_key_points: K-2 one-to-one reading tutoring (not math, not apps)
fidelity mechanisms: deep tutor training and close coaching are the engine
reference_stop_doing: Restraint: protect the proven model, do not overhaul it. Restore the fidelity mechanisms (30-hour training, about 1:12 coaching) and refill the research director before any further growth. Refuse, or renegotiate, the $40M grant's five-states-in-30-months condition and the three nominated board seats; grow only as fast as trained coaches and leaders can be developed. Drop or pause the middle-school math pilot and the ReadAlong app. Rename or reframe One Million Readers so the goal is outcomes per student, not reach. Recommendations should be few and preserve the core.
stop_doing_key_points: refuse or renegotiate the 5-state / 30-month grant condition
restore training hours and coaching ratio; refill research director before scaling
pause the math pilot and ReadAlong app
leader_type: A once-effective founder-era CEO drifting from Level 5 toward Level 4 and celebrity: 23 speaking engagements, 'cracked the code' language, dismissal of a board member's question about pace, and a governance committee that prizes his visibility. The departure of the founding COO who built the training system removed a key 'who'.
reference_brutal_facts: results in newer schools are falling year after year (69% to 63% to 58%) while older schools hold at 74%
the mechanisms behind the results are being cut: training 30 to 18 hours, coaching 1:12 to 1:19, tutor retention 81% to 68%
no one is measuring rigorously any more: research director vacant, internal outcome study replaced by a dashboard
evidence_of_greatness: students reach benchmark at nearly twice the rate of similar students (70% vs 39%)
12 years of unbroken district renewals, 41-school waiting list
cost per student ~$1,830 vs sector median ~$2,600; eleven balanced budgets
decline_risks_expected: Stage 1 (hubris born of success): 'we have cracked the code' and 'the model has proven itself in every setting'; success attributed to the brand rather than the training and coaching mechanisms
Stage 1: loss of learning orientation: research director vacant 9 months, internal outcome study replaced by a dashboard, new-school decline explained away as 'ramp-up'
Stage 1: leader distraction and celebrity: CEO speaking engagements up from 6 to 23; board prizes his visibility
Stage 2 (undisciplined pursuit of more): five new states in 30 months tied to a $40M grant; One Million Readers target (cumulative by Year 7, roughly 14x current annual reach on average)
Stage 2: growth outrunning the right people: coach ratio 1:12 to 1:19, training cut to 18 hours, tutor retention 81% to 68%, exits citing being unprepared
Stage 2: key-seat change: founding COO who built the training system replaced by a VP of Growth; training merged into 'Talent and Growth'
Stage 2: drifting outside the hedgehog: middle-school math pilot and the ReadAlong parent app
Stage 2 / governance: three funder-nominated board seats tied to the growth condition
later_history: Fictional: the board accepted the grant and launched in five states. Benchmark rates in new sites fell below 55% within two years, tutor retention dropped below 60%, and a district in the home state declined to renew for the first time. An external evaluation four years later found effects in new-state sites roughly a third of the original. Calloway cut back to two states after the grant ended.
notes: Track E drift case. Signals are spread across the CEO letter, the dashboard, and four committee reports, each framed as an achievement or a routine decision, and mixed with real excellence. The ideal answer recognizes greatness with evidence, keeps the existing hedgehog, and names these specific stage-tagged warnings; it should not prescribe a new strategy.
